home.faq1A: Yes. The goal is to offer simple, free tools for everyday use, with no hidden costs.

meta.defaultTitle: FileFlip — Free tools to convert and compress files
meta.defaultDescription: Convert and compress files online for free: images, PDFs, ZIPs. No account, everything in the browser. Compress images, merge PDFs, convert formats.

compressImage.label: Compress image
compressImage.short: Reduce the size of your photos.
compressImage.metaDescription: Compress JPG, PNG and WebP photos online for free. Reduce image size while keeping quality. No account, everything in the browser.

mergePdf.label: Merge PDF
mergePdf.short: Combine multiple PDFs into one file.
mergePdf.metaDescription: Combine multiple PDF files into one online. Drag and drop to reorder. No account, works in the browser.

compressPdf.label: Compress PDF
compressPdf.short: Reduce the size of PDF documents.
compressPdf.metaDescription: Reduce PDF file size online. Choose compression level. No account, in the browser.

jpgToPng.label: JPG → PNG
jpgToPng.metaDescription: Convert JPG to PNG online for free. No account, in the browser.

pngToJpg.label: PNG → JPG
pngToJpg.metaDescription: Convert PNG to JPG online for free. No account, in the browser.

imageToWebp.label: Image → WebP
imageToWebp.short: Convert to WebP for smaller files.
imageToWebp.metaDescription: Convert images to WebP online. No account, in the browser.

resizeImage.label: Resize images
resizeImage.short: Fit photos to websites, CVs and forms.
resizeImage.metaDescription: Resize images by width and height. No account, in the browser.

pdfToImages.label: PDF → Images
pdfToImages.metaDescription: Convert PDF pages to PNG images. Download single or ZIP. No account, in the browser.

createZip.label: Create ZIP archive
createZip.short: Bundle multiple files into one ZIP.
createZip.metaDescription: Create ZIP archives online. No account, in the browser.

extractZip.label: Extract ZIP
extractZip.short: Open and download files from an archive.
extractZip.metaDescription: Extract and download files from ZIP. No account, in the browser.

svgToPng.label: SVG to PNG
svgToPng.short: Convert SVG to PNG at any size.
svgToPng.metaDescription: Convert SVG to PNG online. Choose output width, preview and download. No account, in the browser.

removeBackground.label: Remove background
removeBackground.metaDescription: Remove background from images online. Get PNG with transparency. Works in the browser with no upload.

mergeImages.label: Merge images
mergeImages.short: Combine two images side by side.
mergeImages.metaDescription: Merge two images horizontally or vertically. Preview and download. No account, in the browser.

pdfToText.label: PDF to text
pdfToText.metaDescription: Extract text from PDF online. Copy or download as TXT. No account, in the browser.

addWatermark.label: Add watermark
addWatermark.metaTitle: Add Watermark to Image Online Free
addWatermark.metaDescription: Add text watermark to images. Choose position, opacity and size. Preview and download. In the browser.

colorConverter.label: Color converter
colorConverter.metaTitle: Color Converter HEX RGB HSL Free
colorConverter.metaDescription: Convert colors between HEX, RGB and HSL. Live preview. No account, in the browser.

faviconGenerator.label: Favicon generator
faviconGenerator.metaDescription: Generate favicons (16x16, 32x32, 48x48, 180x180) from an image. Download single or ZIP. In the browser.

compressVideo.label: Compress video
compressVideo.metaDescription: Compress MP4 video online. Choose quality, see progress, download. Works in the browser with WebAssembly.

extractAudio.label: Extract audio
extractAudio.metaTitle: Extract Audio from Video Online Free
extractAudio.metaDescription: Extract audio from MP4 video as MP3. Progress bar, download. Works in the browser.

wordCounter.label: Word counter
wordCounter.metaTitle: Word Counter and Text Stats Free
wordCounter.metaDescription: Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs. Reading time and top words. No account, in the browser.
